text:
```yaml
name: macOS ARM PyInstaller

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build SSHPilot.app and DMG on macOS 14 (Apple Silicon)
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
        run: |
          brew install python@3.11
          brew install pyinstaller
          brew install pyqt5  # add any other brew deps required by pyinstaller.sh

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Make pyinstaller.sh executable
        run: chmod +x pyinstaller.sh

      - name: Run pyinstaller.sh
        run: ./pyinstaller.sh

      - name: Archive DMG
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SSHPilot.dmg
          path: dist/SSHPilot.dmg

      - name: Archive compressed app bundle
        run: |
          cd dist
          zip -r SSHPilot.app.zip SSHPilot.app
        shell: bash
      - name: Upload app bundle zip
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SSHPilot.app.zip
          path: dist/SSHPilot.app.zip

      - name: Compute DMG checksum
        run: |
          cd dist
          shasum -a 256 SSHPilot.dmg > SSHPilot.dmg.sha256
        shell: bash
      - name: Upload checksum
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SSHPilot.dmg.sha256
          path: dist/SSHPilot.dmg.sha256
```
